# Front and Clock Sheet: [Front Name]

Read by `/adventure-forge` (Phase 3, open structures) and `/world-seed` (hooks that become fronts).

*Created: [Date]*
*Status: [Draft / Tested / Approved]*

One sheet per threat. A front is what happens if nobody intervenes. Every move must be visible in
the world, so players can notice it and act. Test: remove the players and run the clock; the world
must still change.

## Identity

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Front** | [Faction, person or force] |
| **Agenda** | [What it wants, in one sentence] |
| **Fear behind the agenda** | [What it is trying to avoid] |
| **Method** | [How it pursues the agenda; this produces the obstacles] |
| **Dramatic question it raises** | [One sentence the players' choices will answer] |
| **Stakes** | Personal: [ ] / Community: [ ] / Setting: [ ] |

## Moves (three to five, escalating)

| Step | Move if unopposed | Visible sign in the world | What ticks the clock | Player levers (slow, stop, reverse) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [move] | [what players can see, hear or find] | [time passing / an event / a player action elsewhere] | [lever] |
| 2 | [move] | [sign] | [trigger] | [lever] |
| 3 | [move] | [sign] | [trigger] | [lever] |
| 4 | [optional] | [sign] | [trigger] | [lever] |
| 5 | [final move: the doom if never opposed] | [sign] | [trigger] | [lever] |

|---|---|---|

| Other front | How they collide | What happens if both advance |
|---|---|---|
| [front] | [collision] | [result] |

## Checks

- [ ] Every move has a visible sign
- [ ] Every step has a trigger that does not need the players
- [ ] Every step has at least one player lever
- [ ] The final move changes the world permanently
- [ ] No move prescribes how a player character feels or responds
- [ ] Any numbers on the clock (days, segments) come from a named system or are marked `[number: to set]`
